title: Astrid and the Vow
author: A. M. Reyes
blurb: Freya Nakamura, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
